links.outcome: LLM diagnostic and therapeutic accuracy on clinical vignettes across 12 specialties
links.effect: Therapeutic recommendations were inconsistent: GPT-4o median 10 (IQR 0–10), GPT-3.5-Turbo median 0 (IQR 0–6.3; P=.0005), Claude-3-Sonnet median 5 (IQR 0–10); GPT-4o vs Claude P=.45.
links.quote: However, their inconsistent performance in generating therapeutic recommendations presents a major barrier to clinical adoption.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic and therapeutic accuracy of multiple LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Sonnet, GPT-3.5-Turbo) using 50 clinical vignettes across 12 specialties without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
